capabilities: Add the current note to a future (or past) daily note
Translate natural-language dates into daily note names
Create or append a configurable review section in the target daily note
Embed blocks in the target daily note using a prefix
Set a default review date and hotkey via settings
disambiguation: Not a spaced-repetition scheduler; it just places a link into one future daily note on a date you pick.
extras: Manual installation instructions only; the README references a demo image and gives no automated-install details.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send a note forward to a future daily note as a reminder to review it.

relations.evidence: Review integrates with (and therefore requires) the Natural Language Dates plugin.

summary: Review helper that adds a link to the current note (or selected block) into a future daily note so you revisit it on a chosen date.
